description: Saves a new quote with a quote number from up to 20 jobs (each a product id and configuration, priced by the engine first), with an optional saved address for delivery, pickup where the account has it, an order reference and notes. Prices are locked for 30 days. It is the customer's saved quote, ready to share with a client (share_quote, email_quote) or convert to an order. If a job cannot be priced, nothing is saved. Printdash prints in Australia and delivers within Australia only; prices are in AUD and include GST. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

address_id.description: A saved address id for delivery (list_addresses). Omit to choose at checkout.

fulfilment.description: pickup only where the account has pickup (estimate_delivery says pickup_available).

lines.description: The jobs, each priced by the engine before anything is saved.

configuration.description: The job, as option ids from get_product. Everything optional: the result says what is missing.

attributeSelections.description: Simple products: attribute name to the chosen value's label.

coverStockId.description: Booklets: cover stock id, or self for a self cover.

designs.description: Several different designs with the same specs on one item, where get_product offers designs.

finishingIds.description: Finishing option ids, from every finishing field the customer chose.

height.description: Custom finished height in mm (with width).

pages.description: Booklets: page count, one of the pages field's presets.

quantity.description: How many. With designs above 1, how many of EACH design.

sizeId.description: A preset size id from get_product's size field. Or give width and height for a custom size.

stickerShape.description: Where get_product has a sticker_shape field: an id from it. Stickers: square, circle or custom; labels: rectangle, circle or custom.

stockId.description: Stock id from the stock field.

width.description: Custom finished width in mm (with height), within the size field's limits.

reference.description: The customer's order reference or job name.

name: create_quote

total_inc_gst.description: The quote page's Total, inc GST: subtotal_inc_gst (the lines) plus delivery (shipping_ex_gst) and its GST.

title: Save a quote
